name: CSS Arbitrator
note: R13.8, Captain's Module C2 SSD p.35 (PDF p.36). The Fleet Carrier's STRIKE variant, which in ISC usage means ARMED WITH A PPD - two at FA where the CV mounts two plasma-S at FP, and that is the only difference. The same relation the CVLS has to the CVL and the CS to the CL, one tier up. Everything else was compared against the CV sheet and matches: the CA chassis entire, warp 16 a side, F hull 8, rear hull 8, shields 30/30/24/24/24/30, excess 6, flag bridge, six phaser-3s, six rear-firing plasma-F, crew 50, boarding parties 12, TWELVE DECK CREWS, four balcony positions, and a sixteen-box bay reading as four administrative shuttles and twelve fighters - 7 superiority, 4 assault, 1 EW. Service year 173 against the CV's 172, and point value 176 with WITHOUT PL-F REFIT (PRE Y179) = -12, so 164 is the Y173 hull. SIZE CLASS 3, which E11.16 requires of any PPD hull. Two PPDs means this ship contributes two to E11.17's fleet allowance as flagship, not the cap of four - and with twelve fighters aboard it is the ISC hull most likely to BE the flagship. Its EW fighter will be an FEF rather than the sheet's FEK, for the reason in cvl.json. The Y180 Sabot refit (+9) is absent as elsewhere.

refits.name: PL-F refit
refits.label: Plasma-F
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PL-F REFIT, DELETE ALL PLASMA-F TORPEDOES. SIX here, three a side, the same count and arcs as the Star Cruiser's - which is the clearest sign this is the CA's hull and not the CL's. R13.1C's rear-firing torpedoes, flagged iscRearFiring. The sheet's pseudo-plasma box lists S-type pseudos for A and B and none for these.
